summary: Separate conversation connections from retained Agent history, add a six-hour idle release policy and verified Codex app handoff, and bound diagnostic events while retaining usage and delivery provenance.
migration: Schema 14 backs up existing databases before resumable event cleanup. THREAD_IDLE_MS defaults to six hours and is independent of result TTL; 0 disables automatic release. New installations default to persistent visible threads while saved preferences are preserved. Ephemeral/unknown conversations are protected. Returning from Codex requires its writer to be released.
